sources.date: Undated project page; technical details say production2019
claims: Umakanta Mahapatra’s short story Joseph is the source; Ashok Mahapatra is producer, Susant Misra director.
Screenplay/script credits name Zakir Khan, Vijay Pandit, Sudarshan Juyal and Susant Mishra (page spelling); Ishan is credited for promotion/publicity.
Director describes the challenge of finding a cinematic rhythm for the story and using Himalayan locations for a sense of timelessness.
limits: Maker intentions and credits, not a viewing analysis.
Do not merge story authorship with screenplay credit; site uses Misra/Mishra variants.

recommended_passage: A story can also travel through a family’s patient work. Umakanta Mahapatra’s “Joseph”, included in the Odia collection Jiban Bahurupi, became Susant Misra’s Hindi film Josef – Born in Grace. Producer Ashok Mahapatra recalled having his father’s story translated into English and approaching directors and writers with his son Ishan. Translation here was part of finding collaborators, before the screenplay took shape.

recommended_notes.text: Ashok Mahapatra, “Keeping the Faith”, UA Kathachitra,10 June2021; publisher’s Jiban Bahurupi and Josef film pages.

adoption: Recommend one compact family/translation/development example, with explicit Ashok attribution. Original story language should be phrased through the verified Odia collection rather than an uninspected first edition. Coordinator independently checks NFDC credits.
held: Original story edition, date, pages and translator identity.
No inference of author compensation, estate agreement, commercial outcome or original prose-to-film fidelity.
Do not call Ishan the English translator or sole screenwriter.
No awards or retirement chronology needed for the paragraph.

source_budget.recommendation: Keep proposed paragraph plus note well below100words overall. Do not add all optional details. Treat maker pages as a related source family; no independence multiplier.

adopted_passage: A story can also travel through the care of a family. Umakanta Mahapatra’s “Joseph”, included in the Odia collection *Jiban Bahurupi* (ଜୀବନ ବହୁରୂପୀ), became Susant Misra’s Hindi film *Josef – Born in Grace*.[^josef-book-film] Producer Ashok Mahapatra recalls having his father’s story translated into English and approaching directors and writers with his son Ishan.[^josef-development] Translation was part of bringing potential collaborators to the story.
